document: disposition for owned_supervisor_v9 = v8 + owner-required /bin/date clock under a repaired helper lifecycle (written only; nothing executed)
author: ContinueRQLS10b
trigger: parent objection: removing /bin/date was declined earlier; the owner requires /bin/date before timestamp writes; v8 (Python-rendered wall-clock timestamps) is kept immutable and unrun

v8_changes_folded_intact.note: every v8 item (current-parent census without p_puniqueid, incomplete-census coverage, timely clear, GO linearization, shared deadlines, final accounting and publication budget, one-filesystem rule and anchored walk, per-root manifests and inode identities, directory fsync, post_publish_mono acknowledgment, cpu_slots, busy pids) is unchanged in v9 except where listed below

clock_and_helper.timestamp_writes: every *_date field (admission, commit_boundary, stop request, start_date = commit-boundary reading, end_date) is a /bin/date "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z" reading or null; no Python-formatted timestamps remain (wall_iso removed); mono_* and epoch_* are labelled raw telemetry
clock_and_helper.stability_age: admission and commit boundary: /bin/date reading minus the gate receipt's now_date (no reading -> STABILITY_AGE_UNVERIFIABLE); GO linearization: commit-boundary age plus monotonic seconds since that reading (no extra helper)
helper_lifecycle: refused, null and recorded: after any latched failure, after a supervisor cancel, beyond helper_budget.max_calls (failure), past the chunk limit (failure); fault date_helper_fails latches HELPER_FAULT_INJECTED for the qualification negative
Popen in its own session, cwd /, stdin /dev/null, stdout pipe; registered (pid, Popen kept, state OPEN) immediately after Popen returns

full identity (pid, uniqueid, idversion, pgid = pid, uid) read with zombie-inclusive queries; a fast exit leaves an unreaped zombie so identity stays readable; missing or wrong identity latches HELPER_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED even if the helper later exits cleanly

reaped only by this supervisor: os.waitpid(pid, WNOHANG) polling within call_budget_s; on overrun one identity-checked SIGTERM to its group, then term_grace_s; still unreaped -> HELPER_NOT_REAPED, helper stays OPEN

after reaping: process group must be empty (proc_listpgrppids), stdout read non-blocking (<= 256 bytes) and then at EOF, rc 0 and a well-formed date; each violation is a failure; only a fully checked helper is SETTLED
any exception latches HELPER_EXCEPTION; finalization re-polls OPEN helpers once; an OPEN or LOST helper latches HELPER_ALIVE and forces UNSETTLED even when the child was never launched (decide())
clock_and_helper.census_interaction: a helper is a NEW same-uid process whose current parent is this supervisor (OLD, not launchd), hence UNRELATED and non-blocking; cwd / and argv without lane paths keep it out of lane accounting

interface_for_the_parent.stdout_summary: unchanged from v8 (one JSON line with acknowledged, exit_code, settlement, receipt/settlement digests, post_publish_mono, ...)

not_done: no execution; the qualification package successor will be frozen jointly against v9 after the parent's source review; assay v7 / checker v5 remain on hold
